headline: New Orleans port sues owners of tanker involved in Mississippi crash
summary: Gerald Herbert/AP hide caption The Board of Commissioners of the Port of New Orleans is seeking at least $1 million in damages from people connected to the tanker, which is called Atlantic Asphalt. All passengers and crew survived, including more than 100 who were rescued from the river, leading New Orleans Mayor Helena Moreno to dub the incident "the miracle on the Mississippi." "The extent of said damage remains under investigation, but physical damage is currently estimated to exceed [$1 million], with additional substantial direct, indirect and consequential damages anticipated," the lawsuit reads. Burnham said it is estimated there are 160,000 gallons of fuel on board the ship.
